item.title: Sapporo Ramen Guide: Miso Ramen, Best Shops & How to Eat
item.description: Sapporo is the birthplace of miso ramen, one of Japan’s three great ramen styles — and a bowl built for Hokkaido winters. Rich, hearty and warming, it pairs a deep miso-based pork broth with thick, curly yellow noodles, a slick of lard to keep it piping hot, and toppings like sweetcorn, butter, beansprouts and chashu. Slurping a steaming bowl in a tiny counter shop while snow falls outside is a classic Hokkaido moment.
